status.auto_checked: Machine translation, checked by automatic tests. It has not been reviewed by a person: the French text and the official source are the reference.
status.partial: Machine translation, checked by automatic tests and not reviewed by a person. Passages that did not pass the tests are shown in French. The French text and the official source are the reference.
status.human_reviewed: Translation reviewed by a person. The French text and the official source are the reference.
status.outdated: The French text has changed since it was translated: the translation is withdrawn until it is redone and checked. The text is shown in French.
status.withheld: The machine translation of this content did not pass the checks: the text is shown in French.
status.unavailable: This content is not yet translated into your language: it is shown in French.
meta.machine: Translated on {{date}} by a translation engine installed on the publisher's computer (no personal text is translated).
